# Set Up

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(ggplot2)
library(psych)
library(semPlot)
library(semTools)
library(corrplot)
library(nFactors)
library(parameters)
library(GPArotation)
library(esemComp)
library(pheatmap)
library(parameters)
library(reshape2)
library(qgraph)

options(digits = 3)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load Data

```{r}
# Referred NDD Sample
basc3p <- read_rds("basc3.p.first.child.rds")
bascsub <- basc3p %>% 
  select(basc3_ad_t, basc3_fc_t, basc3_so_t, basc3_dl_t, basc3_le_t, basc3_cp_t, basc3_ha_t, basc3_ag_t, basc3_ax_t, basc3_dp_t, basc3_sm_t, basc3_ay_t, basc3_wd_t, basc3_ap_t) %>% 
  rename(
    Adaptability = basc3_ad_t, 
    Functional.Communication = basc3_fc_t, 
    Social.Skills = basc3_so_t, 
    Activities.of.Daily.Living = basc3_dl_t, 
    Leadership = basc3_le_t, 
    Conduct.Problems = basc3_cp_t, 
    Hyperactivity = basc3_ha_t, 
    Aggression = basc3_ag_t, 
    Anxiety = basc3_ax_t, 
    Depression = basc3_dp_t, 
    Somatization = basc3_sm_t, 
    Atypicality = basc3_ay_t, 
    Withdrawal = basc3_wd_t, 
    Attention.Problems = basc3_ap_t
  )

# General Norm Sample 
gendf <- read.csv("General_Norm_Cor_Matrix.csv", row.names = 1)
R <- as.matrix(gendf)
R[R == ""] <- NA # Convert blanks to NA
R <- apply(R, 2, as.numeric)
R[upper.tri(R)] <- t(R)[upper.tri(R)] # Fill upper triangle
diag(R) <- 1 # Fill diagonals with 1
rownames(R) <- colnames(R)
sds <- c(10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10)
D <- diag(sds)
S <- D %*% R %*% D
rownames(S) <- rownames(R)
colnames(S) <- colnames(R)

# Australian Sample
fullaussie <- read.csv("Australiandata.csv")
fullaussie[fullaussie == "" | fullaussie == " "] <- NA
fullaussie <- fullaussie %>% 
  filter(Form == 5)

aussiesub <- fullaussie %>% 
  select(basc3_ad_t, basc3_fc_t, basc3_so_t, basc3_dl_t, basc3_le_t, basc3_cp_t, basc3_ha_t, basc3_ag_t, basc3_ax_t, basc3_dp_t, basc3_sm_t, basc3_ay_t, basc3_wd_t, basc3_ap_t) %>% 
  rename(
    Adaptability = basc3_ad_t, 
    Functional.Communication = basc3_fc_t, 
    Social.Skills = basc3_so_t, 
    Activities.of.Daily.Living = basc3_dl_t, 
    Leadership = basc3_le_t, 
    Conduct.Problems = basc3_cp_t, 
    Hyperactivity = basc3_ha_t, 
    Aggression = basc3_ag_t, 
    Anxiety = basc3_ax_t, 
    Depression = basc3_dp_t, 
    Somatization = basc3_sm_t, 
    Atypicality = basc3_ay_t, 
    Withdrawal = basc3_wd_t, 
    Attention.Problems = basc3_ap_t
  )

# School Sample
basc3s <- read_csv("prs_schoolonly.csv")

basc3sitems <- basc3s %>% 
  select(Age, "1":"175")

basc3sitems <- basc3sitems %>% 
  mutate(across(c(`1`:`175`), ~ . - 1))
basc3sitems <- basc3sitems %>% 
  mutate(
    ha_raw = rowSums(across(c(`24`, `32`, `42`, `73`, `93`, `99`, `114`, `151`, `159`, `166`, `172`))), 
    ag_raw = rowSums(across(c(`35`, `41`, `50`, `59`, `98`, `106`, `117`, `121`, `146`))), 
    cp_raw = rowSums(across(c(`3`, `7`, `23`, `43`, `55`, `68`, `74`, `141`, `144`, `164`))), 
    ax_raw = rowSums(across(c(`9`, `21`, `31`, `38`, `54`, `67`, `84`, `104`, `107`, `112`, `128`, `136`, `147`, `160`))), 
    dp_raw = rowSums(across(c(`4`, `34`, `40`, `45`, `52`, `60`, `80`, `100`, `110`, `116`, `119`, `124`, `129`))), 
    sm_raw = rowSums(across(c(`6`, `15`, `20`, `39`, `49`, `57`, `63`, `78`, `105`, `118`, `132`, `161`))), 
    ap_raw = rowSums(across(c(`1`, `11`, `28`, `83`, `91`, `127`, `175`))), 
    ay_raw = rowSums(across(c(`12`, `17`, `58`, `81`, `88`, `115`, `122`, `125`, `145`, `152`, `157`, `158`, `167`, `171`))), 
    wd_raw = rowSums(across(c(`48`, `87`, `96`, `101`, `111`, `126`, `156`, `163`, `170`))), 
    ad_raw = rowSums(across(c(`47`, `86`, `92`, `103`, `130`, `133`, `135`, `143`))), 
    so_raw = rowSums(across(c(`2`, `14`, `53`, `77`, `97`, `113`, `134`, `137`, `154`, `174`))), 
    le_raw = rowSums(across(c(`18`, `29`, `62`, `120`, `142`, `155`, `173`))), 
    dl_raw = rowSums(across(c(`22`, `27`, `37`, `46`, `64`, `66`, `90`, `149`, `153`))), 
    fc_raw = rowSums(across(c(`5`, `33`, `56`, `61`, `69`, `76`, `85`, `102`, `109`, `148`, `165`, `168`)))
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    basc3_ha_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((ha_raw - 9.82) / 5.86), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((ha_raw - 7.43) / 4.87)
    ), 
    basc3_ag_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((ag_raw - 3.71) / 3.61), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((ag_raw - 2.83) / 2.76)
    ),
    basc3_cp_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((cp_raw - 5.83) / 3.93), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((cp_raw - 4.72) / 3.61)
    ),
    basc3_ax_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((ax_raw - 10.34) / 5.23), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((ax_raw - 11.64) / 6.18)
    ),
    basc3_dp_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((dp_raw - 6.19) / 4.80), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((dp_raw - 5.79) / 4.79)
    ),
    basc3_sm_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((sm_raw - 4.84) / 3.93), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((sm_raw - 5.33) / 4.16)
    ),
    basc3_ap_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((ap_raw - 7.13) / 4.49), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((ap_raw - 6.48) / 4.30)
    ),
    basc3_ay_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((ay_raw - 4.31) / 4.79), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((ay_raw - 3.67) / 4.27)
    ),
    basc3_wd_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((wd_raw - 4.70) / 3.98), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((wd_raw - 4.69) / 4.23)
    ),
    basc3_ad_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((ad_raw - 14.67) / 5.03), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((ad_raw - 15.48) / 4.61)
    ),
    basc3_so_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((so_raw - 20.04) / 6.23), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((so_raw - 21.29) / 6.09)
    ),
    basc3_le_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((le_raw - 11.52) / 4.51), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((le_raw - 12.24) / 4.34)
    ),
    basc3_dl_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((dl_raw - 16.77) / 4.59), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((dl_raw - 17.95) / 4.43)
    ),
    basc3_fc_t = case_when(
      Age < 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((fc_raw - 24.33) / 6.50), 
      Age >= 8.0 ~ 50 + 10 * ((fc_raw - 25.98) / 6.29)
    )
  )

schoolsub <- basc3sitems |> 
  select(basc3_ad_t, basc3_fc_t, basc3_so_t, basc3_dl_t, basc3_le_t, basc3_cp_t, basc3_ha_t, basc3_ag_t, basc3_ax_t, basc3_dp_t, basc3_sm_t, basc3_ay_t, basc3_wd_t, basc3_ap_t) %>% 
    rename(
    Adaptability = basc3_ad_t, 
    Functional.Communication = basc3_fc_t, 
    Social.Skills = basc3_so_t, 
    Activities.of.Daily.Living = basc3_dl_t, 
    Leadership = basc3_le_t, 
    Conduct.Problems = basc3_cp_t, 
    Hyperactivity = basc3_ha_t, 
    Aggression = basc3_ag_t, 
    Anxiety = basc3_ax_t, 
    Depression = basc3_dp_t, 
    Somatization = basc3_sm_t, 
    Atypicality = basc3_ay_t, 
    Withdrawal = basc3_wd_t, 
    Attention.Problems = basc3_ap_t
  )
```

# =============

# Referred NDD Sample

## Multivariate Skew and Kurtosis

```{r}
res <- psych::mardia(bascsub, na.rm = TRUE)
res$b1p   # multivariate skewness
res$b2p   # multivariate kurtosis
res$p.skew  # p-value for skewness
res$p.kurtosis  # p-value for kurtosis
```

## Hypothesized Structures

### Scoring Structure CFA

```{r}
set.seed(24)
library(lavaan)
scoringbasc <- '
Adapt =~ Functional.Communication + Social.Skills + Leadership + Activities.of.Daily.Living + Adaptability
Ext =~ Conduct.Problems + Hyperactivity + Aggression 
Int =~ Anxiety + Depression + Somatization
BSI =~ Withdrawal + Atypicality + Attention.Problems + Hyperactivity + Aggression + Depression
'
nddscoringfit <- cfa(scoringbasc, data = bascsub, estimator = "MLR")
summary(nddscoringfit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
fitMeasures(nddscoringfit)

dynamic::cfaHB(nddscoringfit, plot=TRUE)

semPaths(nddscoringfit, "std", layout = "tree")
```

### Manual CSA Structure CFA

```{r}
set.seed(24)
library(lavaan)
csabasc <- '
Adapt =~ Functional.Communication + Social.Skills + Leadership + Activities.of.Daily.Living + Adaptability + Attention.Problems + Anxiety
Ext =~ Conduct.Problems + Hyperactivity + Aggression + Attention.Problems
Int =~ Anxiety + Depression + Somatization + Withdrawal + Atypicality + Adaptability
'

nddcsafit <- cfa(csabasc, data = bascsub, estimator = "MLR")
summary(nddcsafit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
fitMeasures(nddcsafit)

semPaths(nddcsafit, "std", layout = "tree")
```

## Determining Number of Factors

### Appropriateness

```{r}
cortest.bartlett(bascsub)
KMO(bascsub)  
```

### Scree Plot

```{r}
set.seed(24)
bascsub_cor_mat <- cor(bascsub, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

pa <- parallel(
  subject = 761,
  var = ncol(bascsub_cor_mat),
  rep = 1000,
  cent = 0.95,
  model = "factors"
)

results <- nScree(
  x = bascsub_cor_mat,
  aparallel = pa$eigen$qevpea,
  model = "factors"
)
plotnScree(results)
```

We chose to go with a 3-factor solution following 3- and 4- factor CFAs and inspection of the fit indices and modification indices. The 4th factor in the 4-factor model had little theoretical support, and there were significant correlated residuals that were also unexplained. It is worth noting, however, that neither model showed good fit according to the fit statistics, even following the addition of modification indices (4-factor: CFI = 0.86, RMSEA = 0.132, SRMR = 0.085; 3-factor: CFI = 0.83, RMSEA = 0.141, SRMR = 0.086). Factor loadings for the 4-factor EFA are in the Supplementary Figures.

## ESEM

### 3-factor EFA

```{r}
set.seed(24)
# 1. EFA stage
bascmlfit <- fa(bascsub, 
                cor = "cor", 
                nfactors = 3, 
                rotate="promax", 
                fm = "minres")
print(bascmlfit, digits=2, sort=TRUE, cut=.30)
bascmlfit$loadings
fa.diagram(bascmlfit)
```

### 3-factor CFA

```{r}
set.seed(24)
# 2. Anchor Factors
referents.3 <- find_referents(bascmlfit, c("Adaptive_Skills", "Externalizing", "Internalizing")) 

# 3. Convert to SEM
basc_model_syntax.3 <- syntax_composer(efa_object = bascmlfit,
                                         referents = referents.3) 

# 4. Fit CFA/ESEM-like model
basc_cfa_fit.3 <- cfa(model = basc_model_syntax.3, 
                      data = bascsub,
                      estimator = "MLR", 
                      std.lv= T) 

# 5. Evaluate model
summary(basc_cfa_fit.3, fit.measures = T, std = T) 
```

## Hypothesized Structures

### Scoring Structure CFA

```{r CFA Manual Scoring Structure}
set.seed(24)
library(lavaan)
scoringbasc <- '
Adapt =~ Functional.Communication + Social.Skills + Leadership + Activities.of.Daily.Living + Adaptability
Ext =~ Conduct.Problems + Hyperactivity + Aggression 
Int =~ Anxiety + Depression + Somatization
BSI =~ Withdrawal + Atypicality + Attention.Problems + Hyperactivity + Aggression + Depression
'
genschoolfit <- cfa(scoringbasc, sample.cov = S,
                        sample.nobs = 600,
                        std.lv = T)
summary(genschoolfit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
fitMeasures(genschoolfit)

dynamic::cfaHB(genschoolfit, plot=TRUE)

semPaths(genschoolfit, "std", layout = "tree")
```

### Manual CSA Structure CFA

```{r CFA Manual EFA Factor Structure}
set.seed(24)
library(lavaan)
csabasc <- '
Adapt =~ Functional.Communication + Social.Skills + Leadership + Activities.of.Daily.Living + Adaptability + Attention.Problems + Anxiety
Ext =~ Conduct.Problems + Hyperactivity + Aggression + Attention.Problems
Int =~ Anxiety + Depression + Somatization + Withdrawal + Atypicality + Adaptability
'

gencsafit <- cfa(csabasc, sample.cov = S,
                        sample.nobs = 600, 
                        std.lv = T)
summary(gencsafit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
fitMeasures(gencsafit)

dynamic::cfaHB(gencsafit, plot=TRUE)

semPaths(gencsafit, "std", layout = "tree")
```

## Determining Number of Factors

### Appropriateness

```{r}
cortest.bartlett(R, 600)
KMO(R)
```

### Scree Plot

```{r}
set.seed(24)
pa <- parallel(
  subject = 600,
  var = ncol(R),
  rep = 1000,
  cent = 0.95,
  model = "factors"
)

results <- nScree(
```

## 3-factor EFA

```{r}
set.seed(24)
# 1. EFA stage
gennormmlfit <- fa(R, 
                cor = "cor", 
                nfactors = 3, 
                n.obs = 600, 
                rotate = "promax", 
                fm = "minres")
print(gennormmlfit, digits=2, sort=TRUE, cut=.30)
gennormmlfit$loadings
fa.diagram(gennormmlfit)
```

## 3-factor CFA

```{r}
set.seed(24)
# 2. Anchor Factors
normreferents.3 <- find_referents(gennormmlfit, c("Adaptive_Skills", "Externalizing", "Internalizing"))

# 3. Convert to SEM
normbasc_model_syntax.3 <- syntax_composer(efa_object = gennormmlfit,
                                         referents = normreferents.3) 

# Constrain Conduct Problems (Heywood case)
adjnormbascmodel <- '
Adaptive_Skills =~ start(0.053)*Hyperactivity+
start(0.03)*Aggression+
0.136*Conduct.Problems+
0.08*Anxiety+
start(-0.126)*Depression+
start(0.078)*Somatization+
start(-0.506)*Attention.Problems+
start(-0.33)*Atypicality+
start(-0.658)*Withdrawal+
start(0.718)*Adaptability+
start(0.937)*Social.Skills+
start(0.978)*Leadership+
start(0.601)*Activities.of.Daily.Living+
start(0.965)*Functional.Communication 

Externalizing =~ start(0.818)*Hyperactivity+
start(0.779)*Aggression+
0.97*Conduct.Problems+
-0.148*Anxiety+
start(0.271)*Depression+
start(0.139)*Somatization+
start(0.445)*Attention.Problems+
start(0.342)*Atypicality+
start(-0.253)*Withdrawal+
start(-0.073)*Adaptability+
start(-0.009)*Social.Skills+
0.121*Leadership+
start(-0.363)*Activities.of.Daily.Living+
start(0.042)*Functional.Communication 

Internalizing =~ start(0.06)*Hyperactivity+
start(0.045)*Aggression+
-0.076*Conduct.Problems+
start(0.953)*Anxiety+
start(0.6)*Depression+
start(0.542)*Somatization+
start(-0.092)*Attention.Problems+
start(0.213)*Atypicality+
start(0.275)*Withdrawal+
start(-0.076)*Adaptability+
start(0.21)*Social.Skills+
0.05*Leadership+
start(0.078)*Activities.of.Daily.Living+
start(0.071)*Functional.Communication 
' 

# 4. Fit CFA/ESEM-like model
normbasc_cfa_fit.3 <- cfa(model = adjnormbascmodel,
                        sample.cov = R,
                        sample.nobs = 600, 
                        std.lv = T, 
                        sample.cov.rescale = FALSE) 

# 5. Evaluate model
summary(normbasc_cfa_fit.3, fit.measures = T, std = T) 
```

```{r}
  aparallel = pa$eigen$qevpea,
  model = "factors"
)
plotnScree(results)
```

## ESEM

### 3-factor EFA

```{r}
set.seed(24)
# 1. EFA stage
schoolmlfit <- fa(schoolsub, cor = "cor", nfactors = 3, rotate="promax", fm = "minres")
print(schoolmlfit, digits=2, sort=TRUE, cut=.30)
bascmlfit$loadings
fa.diagram(schoolmlfit)
```

### 3-factor CFA

```{r}
set.seed(24)
# 2. Anchor Factors
referents.3 <- find_referents(schoolmlfit, c("Externalizing", "Adaptive_Skills", "Internalizing"))

# 3. Convert to SEM
school_model_syntax.3 <- syntax_composer(efa_object = schoolmlfit,
                                         referents = referents.3)

writeLines(school_model_syntax.3)

# 4. Fit CFA/ESEM-like model
school_cfa_fit.3 <- cfa(model = school_model_syntax.3,
                        data = schoolsub, 
                        estimator = "MLR", 
                        std.lv= T) 

# 5. Evaluate model 
summary(school_cfa_fit.3, fit.measures = T, std = T) 
```

```{r}
# 1. Get Loading Matrices
nddloadings <- lavInspect(basc_cfa_fit.3, "std")$lambda
genloadings<- lavInspect(normbasc_cfa_fit.3, "std")$lambda

aussieloadings <- lavInspect(aussie_cfa_fit.3, "std")$lambda

genloadings <- genloadings[rownames(nddloadings), ]

# 2. Run Factor Congruence Functions
nddvgen <- factor.congruence(nddloadings, genloadings)
nddvaussie <- factor.congruence(nddloadings, aussieloadings)
matches1 <- apply(nddvaussie, 1, which.max)
nddvaussie_reordered <- nddvaussie[, matches1]

genvaussie <- factor.congruence(genloadings, aussieloadings)
matches2 <- apply(genvaussie, 1, which.max)
genvaussie_reordered <- genvaussie[, matches2]

nddvschool <- factor.congruence(nddloadings, schoolloadings)
matches4 <- apply(nddvschool, 1, which.max)

genvschool <- factor.congruence(genloadings, schoolloadings)
```

### qgraph

```{r}
# Generate loading matrix
std <- standardizedSolution(basc_cfa_fit.3)
std <- std %>%
  mutate(
    rhs = recode(
      rhs,
      basc3_ax_t = "Anxiety",
      basc3_dp_t = "Depression",
      basc3_sm_t = "Somatization",
      basc3_wd_t = "Withdrawal",
      basc3_ap_t = "Attention\nProblems",
      basc3_ha_t = "Hyperactivity",
      basc3_ag_t = "Aggression",
      basc3_cp_t = "Conduct\nProblems",
      basc3_ad_t = "Adaptability",
      basc3_le_t = "Leadership",
      basc3_so_t = "Social\nSkills",
      basc3_fc_t = "Functional\nCommunication",
      basc3_dl_t = "Activities of\nDaily Living",
      basc3_ay_t = "Atypicality"
    )
  )

loads <- subset(std, op == "=~")

loading_mat <- acast(
  loads,
  rhs ~ lhs,
  value.var = "est.std"
)

# Convert factor loading matrix to edge list
edges <- melt(loading_mat)
names(edges) <- c("Item", "Factor", "Loading")

# Keep only salient loadings
edges <- subset(edges, abs(Loading) >= .20)

# Define nodes
items <- rownames(loading_mat)
factors <- colnames(loading_mat)
nodes <- c(items, factors)

# Create qgraph edge list
edge_list <- data.frame(
  from = match(edges$Item, nodes),
  to = match(edges$Factor, nodes),
  weight = edges$Loading
)

# Edge colors
edge_colors <- ifelse(edges$Loading > 0,
                      "#2166AC",   # blue
                      "#B2182B")   # red

# Node colors
node_colors <- c(
  rep("#D9EAF7", length(items)),    # light blue items
  "#66C2A5",                        # factor 1
  "#FC8D62",                        # factor 2
  "#8DA0CB"                         # factor 3
)

# Layout
# Get spring layout coordinates
tmp <- qgraph(
  edge_list,
  DoNotPlot = TRUE,
  layout = "spring"
)
L <- tmp$layout

# Widen horizontally
L[,1] <- L[,1] * 2

# Slightly increase vertical spacing
L[,2] <- L[,2] * 1.5

# Graph
qgraph(
  edge_list,
  labels = nodes,
  shape = c(
    rep("square", length(items)),
    rep("circle", length(factors))
  ),
  color = node_colors,
  edge.color = edge_colors,
  vsize = c(
    rep(8, length(items)),
    rep(14, length(factors))
  ),
  label.cex = 1.8,
  edge.label.cex = 1.0,
  edge.labels = FALSE,
  layout = L,
  theme = "colorblind"
)
```
